The '''BX-23 Probe Droid''' was a model of floating cube-shaped [[Droid/Legends|droid]] available during the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="LotS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref> One such droid was present on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]<ref name="BX23" /> during or after [[3626 BBY]].<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}} mentions that the events of ''Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught'' transition into 3626 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], meaning the subsequent expansion ''Legacy of the Sith'' must take place sometime afterward.</ref> BX-23 Probe Droids were plated in a [[Color/Legends|green]] color with silver plating around most of the edges. The droid had a [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] on the center of one of its side faces and three [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojectors]], one below its photoreceptor, one on its right side, and one on its top face. The droid model also had two vents on its left face and a periscope on its top face.<ref name="BX23" />

The [[P1-XL]] droid was identical in shape to the BX-23 Probe Droid, but with orange plating.<ref name="P1XL">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20220502-0|text=Celebrate May the 4th in ''The Old Republic''}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
On [[May 3]], [[2023]], the BX-23 was announced to appear<ref name="BX23" /> in the [[2021]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|''Legacy of the Sith'']] to [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Legacy">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref> The droid was made available as a minipet in honor of ''[[Star Wars]]'' day, [[May 4]], and was gifted to players who logged in between May 4 and [[May 18]] of that year.<ref name="BX23" />

The pet shares its model with P1-XL, the minipet for ''Star Wars'' day [[2022]].<ref name="P1XL" />
